title: calculateOverallScore applies the weighted category formula
description: TrustScoreService.recalculate documents the algorithm as Security×0.30 + Compliance×0.30 + Performance×0.20 + Financial×0.20 (CATEGORY_WEIGHTS in trust-score.schema.ts). Verify the pure function produces this exact weighted sum, not a simple average.
preconditions: Unit test harness with no DB dependency
expectedResult: Function returns 68, confirming the weighted formula (not an unweighted average of 67.5) is applied exactly as documented.

title: recalculate() resolves each category score with assessment > evidence-average > default(50) precedence
description: TrustScoreService.recalculate's resolveScore() checks categoryScoresFromAssessment first, falls back to avgEvidenceScores, and finally defaults to 50 when neither source has data for a category.
preconditions: Vendor has one closed assessment with score.categoryScores.security = 75
Vendor has two closed evidence items in category 'compliance' with verificationScore 80 and 60 (average 70)
Vendor has no assessment or evidence data for 'financial'
steps: Inspect the persisted security, compliance, and financial component scores
expectedResult: security = 75 (from assessment), compliance = 70 (rounded average of 80/60 from evidence), financial = 50 (default fallback, no data source available).

title: S3Service.validateFile rejects disallowed MIME types, empty files, and oversized files
description: s3.service.ts enforces ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES whitelist, a minimum size > 0, and MAX_FILE_SIZE = 500 MB.
expectedResult: All three calls return { valid: false } with a descriptive error: unsupported type, 'File is empty.', and a size-limit message citing the 500 MB cap respectively.

title: S3Service.generateKey sanitizes filenames and normalizes the category segment
description: generateKey() strips characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9.\-_] from the filename, collapses repeated underscores, truncates to 200 chars, and lowercases/hyphenates the category into the vendors/{vendorId}/evidence/{category}/{year}/{month}/{ts}-{filename} pattern.
expectedResult: The category segment becomes 'technical-document' (lowercased, spaces to hyphens, punctuation stripped) and the filename segment becomes 'my_report_final_2.pdf' (special chars replaced with underscore, no double underscores), embedded under vendors/v1/evidence/technical-document/{year}/{month}/{ts}-....

title: isValidTransition/getAllowedTransitions enforce the vendor_evidence state machine exactly as defined in FEATURE_WORKFLOWS
description: feature-workflows.ts defines vendor_evidence transitions including draft→assigned, needs_revision→re_assign, and archived→draft/assigned restore paths. There is deliberately no draft→closed shortcut.
expectedResult: First call returns false (draft must go through assigned → under_review → closed). Second call returns true. Third call returns exactly ['draft', 'assigned'] per the defined restore paths.

title: WorkflowTransitionService.transition rejects an invalid edge and reports the allowed list in the thrown error
description: WorkflowTransitionService.transition() calls isValidTransition() and, on failure, throws AppError.workflowTransitionInvalid(currentState, targetState, allowed) so API consumers can render valid next-state options.
preconditions: A vendor_assessment document exists with status = 'closed' (terminal for this entity type)
expectedResult: Throws an error whose payload includes currentState='closed', attemptedState='in_progress', and allowedTransitions=[] (closed has no outbound edges for vendor_assessment) — no document mutation occurs and no workflow_entries row is inserted.

title: QuestionnaireTemplateService.update strips status/publishedAt/publishedBy and auto-increments minorVersion on every draft save
description: VM-022 fix: update() deliberately deletes any client-supplied status/publishedAt/publishedBy from the payload (those are workflow-managed) and sets payload.minorVersion = (doc.minorVersion ?? 0) + 1 unconditionally.
preconditions: A draft questionnaire template exists with minorVersion = 2
steps: Call questionnaireTemplateService.update(orgId, id, userId, { name: 'Updated name', status: 'active' })
expectedResult: The saved document has minorVersion = 3 and status remains 'draft' — the client-supplied status:'active' is silently dropped rather than causing a workflow-transition error or an unintended state change.

title: resolveEffectivePermissions applies a per-partner override only while enabled and not expired
description: TrustNetworkService.resolveEffectivePermissions merges config.dataPermissions with partner.permissionOverride.overrides, but only when override.enabled is true and override.expiresAt (if set) is still in the future; otherwise it falls back to the org's global defaultSharingLevel/dataPermissions.
preconditions: Partner has a permissionOverride with sharingLevel = 'full' and expiresAt set to yesterday
expectedResult: Returned sharingLevel is 'basic' (global default) — the expired override is ignored, not applied. Re-running with expiresAt set to tomorrow returns sharingLevel = 'full'.
